title: Clover
description: One low clover patch for a 0.5 m yard cell: three trefoils of flat green leaflets and three round flower heads on stems, two pink and one white. A single mesh node `crop` (materials crop + petal + head), instanced.
checks: TOP tile: three three-leaf clovers (each three leaflets in a Y) and three round flower heads, inside the 0.5 m cell
3/4 tile: two pink flower heads and one white one stand above the low leaves on thin stems
FRONT tile: the tallest flower head reaches the top of the box (0.3 m), the stems start on the grid line
